readme.summary: This is a monorepo-level README that redirects users to sub-package READMEs rather than documenting @fluentui/web-components itself, providing almost no actionable content for the specific package.
readme.top_issue: The README is for the entire fluentui monorepo, not the @fluentui/web-components package — it contains no installation instructions, code examples, or configuration docs for the actual package being evaluated.
